unit.why: A short anecdote: during a pious act, a tzaddik falls into a well through rapt devekut and is unharmed.
unit.boundary_note: This is one numbered item in a series of anecdotes about the same tzaddik. The previous and next divisions are separate items.

stories.start_quote: פ"א הלך לשאוב מי באר לשם
stories.summary_en: Once, while drawing water for matzot mitzvah, the tzaddik was so absorbed in devekut that he fell into the well, but he came to no harm because the water was shallow.

quotes: ומגודל דביקותו נפל תוך בארות המים
tags.why: Rapt attachment to God causes his fall.

quotes: ומגודל דביקותו נפל תוך בארות המים
tags.why: He is depicted in a state of devekut.

quotes: לשאוב מי באר לשם מצת מצוה
tags.why: He draws water for Passover matzot (mayim shelanu), on the eve of Pesach.
The anecdote illustrates the tzaddik's piety and fervor.
Fervor during a mitzvah act is implied.
